patch.value: GH-1729: the extension test harness passes a compact output_format receipt that the native CLI refuses with extension_read_output_invalid since 2026.11.13

GH-1729 (filed 2026-11-14, reproduced on the 2026.11.7, 2026.11.13 and 2026.11.14 artifacts). An extension command declares read_output { row_keys: ["rows"] } and an output_format service returns a compact receipt ({ ok: true, output: "receipt.md" }). The native CLI on 2026.11.13 and 2026.11.14 refuses the receipt-only handler result with exit 2 and extension_read_output_invalid before the formatter receipt, while the same result with a rows array passes. createExtensionTestHarness().runCommand() handles both, so a package author cannot detect the native refusal before adoption; 2026.11.7 accepted both. Expected from the issue: make native output admission testable through the public harness, or document that the harness validates only the handler result and requires a packed native probe; if declared row keys are intentionally mandatory before custom formatting, document the compatible compact receipt pattern and migration. Malformed and oversized output must stay refused. Duplicate check: searched extension read_output row_keys output_format receipt harness native refusal; no open item.

A regression fixture distinguishes receipt-only output, valid rows with compact formatter output, malformed rows and oversized delivered output across the native CLI and the test harness; Package authors can detect the native refusal before adoption, either through the harness or a documented packed-native probe; Valid compact output stays compact and malformed or oversized output stays refused
The harness and the native CLI agree on whether a compact formatter receipt is admitted
The harness passes a receipt that the native CLI refuses with extension_read_output_invalid
